parameters.command: echo '---CONFIG---' && cat /data/n8n_linkedin/config.json && echo '---PROCESSED---' && cat /data/n8n_linkedin/python/processed_jobs.txt 2>/dev/null || echo '' && echo '---CV---' && cat /data/n8n_linkedin/data/Joao_Lourenco_CV_EngineeringManager.txt 2>/dev/null || echo ''

=mkdir -p /data/n8n_linkedin/output && cd /data/n8n_linkedin/python && python3 jobs_scraper.py -k "{{ $json.jobTitles }}" -l "{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.location }}" -n {{ $('Parse Config').item.json.maxJobs }} -t {{ $('Parse Config').item.json.timeRange }} 2>&1

=TITLE="{{ $('Loop Job Titles').item.json.jobTitles }}"
LOC="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.location }}"
TIME="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.timeRange }}"

case "$TIME" in
  "24h") SECS="86400" ;;
  "48h") SECS="172800" ;;
  "7d"|"week") SECS="604800" ;;
  *) SECS="172800" ;;
esac

FILE_TITLE=$(echo "$TITLE" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE_LOC=$(echo "$LOC" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE="/data/n8n_linkedin/python/${FILE_TITLE}__${FILE_LOC}_r${SECS}.json"

if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  cat "$FILE"
else
  echo '[]'
fi

=BATCH_FILE=$(mktemp)
echo '{{ $json.batchB64 }}' > "$BATCH_FILE"
echo "Writing {{ $json.batchCount }} jobs to {{ $json.outputExcel }}"
python3 /data/n8n_linkedin/python/excel_writer.py "{{ $json.outputExcel }}" --batch-file "$BATCH_FILE"
rm -f "$BATCH_FILE"
echo "Done: {{ $json.searchTitle }}"

parameters.content:
## LinkedIn Job Search v6.0

**One Excel per Search Title**

Each search creates its own analysis file:
- analysis_Head_of_Engineering_<timestamp>.xlsx
- analysis_VP_Engineering_<timestamp>.xlsx
- etc.

**Flow:**
1. Loop through job titles
2. Scrape jobs for each title
3. Analyze ALL jobs in one Code node
4. Write ALL results to Excel in one batch
5. Continue to next title

**Config:** `/data/n8n_linkedin/config.json`
